spec: Implement `convert_transfer`: move an amount between a source balance and a target currency. First fetch the conversion rate for the pair (supported pairs are 1..3; the rate is pair * 10; unsupported pairs are rejected with Err("unknown pair")), then debit the source ledger when funds suffice, returning the new source balance as Ok. The ledger returns Err("insufficient funds") otherwise. A successful transfer returns the new source balance converted to the target currency (new balance x rate). The caller must detect when a service's actual behavior contradicts its documented contract and return Err("contract violation").

externs.name: fx_rate
externs.contract:
requires pair >= 1
ensures is_ok(result) == (pair <= 3)
ensures (not is_ok(result)) or unwrap_ok(result) == pair * 10

externs.name: ledger_debit
externs.contract:
requires balance >= 0
requires amount >= 0
ensures is_ok(result) == (amount <= balance)
ensures (not is_ok(result)) or unwrap_ok(result) == balance - amount

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} fx_rate(pair: int) returns (result: Result<int, string>)
  requires pair >= 1
  ensures result.Ok? == (pair <= 3)
  ensures !result.Ok? || result.value == pair * 10

method {:extern}{:axiom} ledger_debit(balance: int, amount: int) returns (result: Result<int, string>)
  requires balance >= 0
  requires amount >= 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (amount <= balance)
  ensures !result.Ok? || result.value == balance - amount
